name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: GTM Automation & AI Agent Systems Builder
summary: Revenue operations builder with 5+ years designing and shipping AI-driven automation for GTM teams, from lead enrichment and outreach to full agent architectures with custom evaluation logic. Fluent in translating loosely-defined business intent into working prompts, workflows, and code (SQL for Power BI/BigQuery/GA4, Python and JavaScript in automation-platform code steps), and in bridging non-technical stakeholders and technical execution. Built and shipped 20+ production automation workflows spanning capture, qualification, booking, and retention.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Architected and deployed a complete GoHighLevel marketing-automation system, 20+ production workflows spanning lead capture/tagging/routing, qualification, appointment booking, no-show recovery, onboarding, and retention.
Broke down manual workflows into agent architectures with custom logic, writing Python and JavaScript in Zapier/Make/n8n code steps to extend automation beyond point-and-click configuration.
Translated non-technical stakeholders' generalized ideas and feedback into precise, structured AI prompts and agent instructions, acting as the bridge between business intent and reliable LLM output.

Designed self-improving evaluation loops and built rubric-based grading criteria to monitor AI agent output quality, performing the underlying data labeling personally to keep the feedback loop grounded.

Built SQL-backed performance dashboards (Power BI, BigQuery/GA4) tracking pipeline velocity, funnel progression, and automation ROI, giving client stakeholders the data to decide which workflows to scale next.
Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of B2B clients, translating operational requirements directly into automated system design.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, translating GTM data into optimization recommendations delivered through QBRs.
Managed multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, bridging business priorities and technical execution.
Ran Google keyword research and search-term analysis to shape campaign targeting and content direction with data rather than intuition.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Advised on A/B testing strategy for a Salesforce-based workflow-automation effort, defining test structure and success criteria for the team building it.
Labeled and defined the CRM fields required for outbound sales and onboarding workflows, standardizing data capture across the team.
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Built Zapier automations integrating Accelo's CRM/PSA platform with client systems, hands-on automation-building history predating Solenzo by several years.
Sold and scoped Accelo's own CRM/PSA (professional services automation) platform to agencies, advising on workflow design, contact management, and pipeline automation configuration.
Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, building relationships with C-suite executives as a trusted advisor on operational system design.
Ranked top three in sales on a team that scaled from 8 to 15 reps, holding that rank across all but the final few months of a 27-month tenure while quota roughly doubled.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO (2009)
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (2024)
